CP30 FFR 2030 gross onshore energy = ES1 Generation (GWh) Onshore Wind 57758.45 + ES1 Curtailment (TWh) Onshore Wind 12.44079 = 70199.24 GWh on 27326.37 MW (CF 0.293), divided by the pre-factor available energy of the CP30 shared-network onshore fleet (2573 units; named REPD + proxy) on weather-year 2013 ERA5 profiles, 92241 GWh (no hours clipped). Calibrates AVAILABLE energy before curtailment to CP30 gross because curtailment is a model output; dispatch is validated against ES1 generation post-solve (scripts/CP30/energy_validation.py). Replaces the stacked carrier default 0.805. Weather-pinned: refit for any other renewables_year. Audit 26 Sep 2026. Refit 27 Sep 2026 after the generator fixes (MW site profiles divided by the capacity they were built on, not the trimmed/split unit p_nom; placement exclusions): pre-factor available energy of the rebuilt fleet (2898 units) is 91761.61 GWh, so 70199.24 / 91761.61 = 0.7650 (was 0.7610 on 92241 GWh).

CP30 FFR 2030 gross marine energy = ES1 Generation (GWh) Marine 113.49 (Transmission) + 290.10 (Distributed) = 403.59 GWh on 254.36 MW (CF 0.181); ES1 has no marine curtailment line, so gross = generation. Divided by the pre-factor available energy of the CP30 shared-network marine fleet (7 proxy units, all on the capacity-normalised tidal_stream_2013 fleet-average profile in add_renewable_generators; fleet CF 0.21834, no hours clipped), 486.49 GWh. The seeded regeneration of the tidal profile (generate_marine_profiles.py) gives 485.75 GWh, a factor of 0.8309 (0.15% apart). Calibrates AVAILABLE energy to CP30 gross; dispatch is validated post-solve (scripts/CP30/energy_validation.py). Weather-pinned. Audit 26 Sep 2026.

CP30 FFR 2030 gross solar energy = ES1 Generation (GWh) Solar PV + ES1 Curtailment (TWh) Solar PV = 49669.66 GWh on 47354 MW (CF 0.1197), divided by the pre-factor available energy of the CP30 shared-network solar fleet (8849 units; named REPD + proxy increment) on weather-year 2013 ERA5 profiles, 48490.55 GWh: factor 1.0243 (1.024316). Derived after the 27 Sep 2026 profile fixes: MW site profiles divided by the capacity each column was built on, named CfD/merchant tranches reading their own site column, and the proxy fleet-average profile normalised by column capacity rather than column peak (atlite solar peaks at ~0.8 of capacity, so the peak basis had put the increments at CF 0.145 against 0.118). Above 1 because the raw atlite CSi latitude-optimal profile (fleet CF 0.117) is below CP30's gross solar CF; clipping at p_max_pu 1.0 removes 0.0005 GWh (67 unit-hours on 1.2 MW units). Replaces the stacked carrier default 0.8939. Calibrates AVAILABLE energy to CP30 gross because curtailment is a model output; dispatch is validated against ES1 generation post-solve (scripts/CP30/energy_validation.py). Weather-pinned: refit for any other renewables_year. Audit 27 Sep 2026.

CP30 FFR 2030 gross offshore energy = ES1 Generation (GWh) Offshore Wind 184441.95 transmission + 2223.49 distributed + ES1 Curtailment (TWh) Offshore Wind 10.80098 = 197466.42 GWh (ES1 is the unconstrained dispatch), divided by the available energy of the CP30 shared-network offshore fleet (50.65 GW) on weather-year 2013 profiles with the 2030 LCCC regional factors, 204955.2 GWh: k = 0.963461, applied to the LCCC regional factor 0.8828600 so the regional shape is kept. User decision 28 Sep 2026 (re-applied with the must-run package). Weather-pinned: refit for any other renewables_year.
